name: DST New York: weekly Friday 09:00 keeps the local hour across spring-forward
note: America/New_York enters DST on Sunday 2026-03-08 at 02:00 local. Friday Mar 6 is still EST (UTC-5), so 09:00 local is 14:00Z. Fridays Mar 13 and Mar 20 are EDT (UTC-4), so 09:00 local is 13:00Z. The wall-clock hour the Tenant configured is preserved; only the UTC instant shifts, by one hour.
